turns.text:
Set the metronome to **♩ = 80** and play in **3/4**. That gives your six eighth notes exactly one bar, with no need to change the motif. Every note below is an eighth note, including the left-hand patterns. **C4 is middle C**, and right-hand finger numbers run from **1 (thumb)** to **5 (pinky)**.

## A minor

Keep the original pitches in bar 1. The left-hand A makes them sound like the start of an A-minor phrase; the **E7 → Am** cadence brings it home. The only G♯ is in bar 3.

| Bar | Chord | Right-hand melody | RH fingering | Left-hand broken chord |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Am** | C4 – E4 – G4 – A4 – G4 – E4 | 1–2–4–5–4–2 | A2 – C3 – E3 – C3 – E3 – C3 |
| 2 | **Dm/F** (1st inversion) | F4 – E4 – D4 – C4 – D4 – F4 | 5–4–3–2–3–5 | F2 – A2 – D3 – A2 – D3 – A2 |
| 3 | **E7** | E4 – D4 – B3 – E4 – G♯4 – B4 | 3–2–1–2–3–5 | E2 – B2 – D3 – B2 – D3 – B2 |
| 4 | **Am** | A4 – G4 – E4 – C4 – E4 – A4 | 5–4–2–1–2–5 | A2 – C3 – E3 – C3 – E3 – C3 |

## C minor

Use **E♭ and A♭** in the opening motif. In bar 3, play **B♮** over G7 for the pull back to C; in bar 4, return to **B♭**.

| Bar | Chord | Right-hand melody | RH fingering | Left-hand broken chord |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Cm** | C4 – E♭4 – G4 – A♭4 – G4 – E♭4 | 1–2–4–5–4–2 | C3 – E♭3 – G3 – E♭3 – G3 – E♭3 |
| 2 | **Fm/A♭** (1st inversion) | A♭4 – G4 – F4 – E♭4 – F4 – A♭4 | 5–4–3–2–3–5 | A♭2 – C3 – F3 – C3 – F3 – C3 |
| 3 | **G7** | G4 – F4 – D4 – G4 – B♮4 – D5 | 3–2–1–2–3–5 | G2 – D3 – F3 – D3 – F3 – D3 |
| 4 | **Cm** | C5 – B♭4 – G4 – E♭4 – G4 – C5 | 5–4–2–1–2–5 | C3 – E♭3 – G3 – E♭3 – G3 – E♭3 |

For an easier first pass, play **only the first left-hand note of each bar** on beat 1. Once the melody and hand shifts feel comfortable, fill in the broken chords.
